newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chiyoda Corp head to resign over poor earnings.
newsitem.headline: Chiyoda Corp head to resign over poor earnings.

text.p: Chiyoda Corp said on Friday that its president would resign on December 1 over poor earnings in the six months to September 30.

The plant engineering company decided at a board meeting on Friday that president Masaaki Kashiwara would resign his post and vice president Masato Kitagawa take over on December 1, a company spokesman said.
"In order to freshen management following poor earnings in the last half-year period, we decided to change presidents," he said.
Kashiwara would become an advisor to the company, he said.
Chiyoda is expected to announce its half-year business results later on Friday.
In September, Chiyoda forecast a parent current loss of 17 billion yen for the business year to March 31, 1997, against a previous forecast of a 1.5 billion yen profit.
